name: Whipped and Steamy • Cosplay Café
source:
Come and relax with a hot and steamy coffee! In a town where adult entertainment is the new best thing, the Whipped and Steamy Café is the best fun for all cosplayers with a wild and adventurous side! No shirts, no shoes, no shame, and only the best service!

But this café needs an extra pair of hands to stay steamy. Fortunately, our brand new hire, Caffie, just got the job! With a stoic demeanour and an utter lack of interest in the job, she’ll have to manage the plans and decorations of the everyday, and meet up with the clientele. And, who knows? Maybe even make some unlikely friends…

Enough about that. Fire up for an experience that only a cosplay café can provide! Here’s hoping your time at the café is just like we like our coffee: Hot, steamy, and with skimpy clothing!

[From [url=https://whalesandgames.itch.io/whipped-and-steamy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
快来喝杯热气腾腾的咖啡放松一下吧！在一个以成人娱乐为新风尚的小镇，鞭打和热气腾腾的咖啡馆是所有具有狂野和冒险一面的角色扮演者的最佳乐趣！不穿衬衫，不穿鞋子，没有羞耻，只有最好的服务！

但这家咖啡馆需要额外的人手才能保持热气腾腾。幸运的是，我们的新员工Caffie刚刚得到了这份工作！由于性格坚忍，对工作完全缺乏兴趣，她必须管理日常的计划和装饰，并与客户会面。而且，谁知道呢？甚至可能结交一些不太可能的朋友……

够了。快来享受只有角色扮演咖啡馆才能提供的体验吧！希望你在咖啡馆的时光就像我们喜欢的咖啡一样：热气腾腾、穿着暴露！
